criteria.requirement: Add Resolver.get_by_segments(node, segments, *, absolute=False). Segments are a finite iterable of strings, never a single string/bytes. Treat slash, empty strings, dots, dot-dot and wildcard text as literal child attribute values, preserving pathattr, ignorecase, relax and existing first-match rules. Relative empty segments return the start node. Absolute mode starts at node.root and requires an explicit root-name first segment. Preserve get/glob and their navigation rules.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
